verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator app, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no first-party capability to export TOTP seeds or other data in an open format. Community reports say there is no export option and describe only hacky user-side extraction through a deprecated Chrome extension or a debug-mode Electron app, which earns no credit. The encrypted backup/sync feature and the developer 'Migrating from Authy to Verify' doc are adjacent features, not user data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
